name: STAR Attitude — modified Rodrigues parameters
summary: Modified Rodrigues parameters: conversion with quaternions, direction cosine matrices and rotation vectors, shadow set and switching, composition of rotations through quaternions (no division by zero at a full turn) and the kinematic equation; within 6e-16 of Basilisk and 2e-15 of SciPy on 601 pairs with norms from 1e-8 to 5.
reference: By hand from the definition sigma = e tan(phi / 4) (Schaub and Junkins, Analytical Mechanics of Space Systems): the quaternion (1/2, 1/2, 1/2, 1/2), 120 degrees about (1, 1, 1), has sigma = (1/3, 1/3, 1/3); a half turn about z has sigma = (0, 0, 1)

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-03: mrp_from_quaternion(), quaternion_from_mrp(), shadow(), switch(), compose(), dcm_from_mrp(), rotation_vector_from_mrp(), mrp_from_rotation_vector(), mrp_rate()
review.G-04: quaternions scalar first; matrix reference to body; compose(first, second) = C(second) C(first); radians and rad/s
review.G-06: no external data; cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO, no state
review.G-13: ValueError for every invalid input; at exactly half a turn either MRP of norm 1 may be returned, stated in the README
